messages.title: Messages & inbox
messages.description: Automation that handles incoming conversations so you don’t reply to everything manually.

content.title: Content & publishing
content.description: Automation that publishes scheduled content on time without you pressing the button.

reports.title: Reports & digests
reports.description: Summaries and alerts emailed automatically instead of you remembering to check.

insights.title: AI & insights
insights.description: Background jobs that keep recommendations and KPIs fresh without manual refresh.

dm-auto-reply.title: Auto-reply to DMs
dm-auto-reply.description: Reads unread conversations and writes replies — as drafts or sends directly.
dm-auto-reply.explainer: The job reads new DMs, writes a reply suggestion, and puts it in the Messages queue. In default mode nothing is sent until you press send. Auto-send needs an extra confirmation.
dm-auto-reply.exampleDraft: Hi! Thanks for reaching out — definitely interested. Send more about the setup and we’ll get back soon.
dm-auto-reply.trustNote: Draft before send by default — you approve before anything goes out.

publish-scheduled-posts.title: Publish scheduled posts
publish-scheduled-posts.description: Sweeps every 15 minutes, retries failed posts once, and publishes what’s due.

sales-outreach-auto.title: Automatic outreach
sales-outreach-auto.description: Creates follow-up email drafts for due leads and quiet leads (10+ days without contact).
sales-outreach-auto.explainer: When a lead is due or quiet too long, a follow-up draft is created in the Sales queue. You review, edit and send — the automation does not send on its own.
sales-outreach-auto.exampleDraft: Hi! Just following up on our earlier chat — have you had a chance to look at the proposal?
sales-outreach-auto.trustNote: Drafts in the queue only — no outreach sends without you.

content-pipeline.title: Content pipeline
content-pipeline.description: Seeds repurpose/gap/evergreen ideas and moves queued posts into scheduled publishing.

cart-recovery.title: Cart recovery
cart-recovery.description: Sends recovery emails to customers who left a Shopify cart (deduplicated).

review-reply-auto.title: Automatic review replies
review-reply-auto.description: Creates reply drafts for new reviews and sends urgent mail at ≤2★ — you approve on Reviews.
review-reply-auto.explainer: New reviews get a reply draft under Reviews. At ≤2★ you may get an urgent email — the reply itself publishes only when you approve.
review-reply-auto.exampleDraft: Thanks for your feedback — we’re taking it internally and happy to follow up.
review-reply-auto.trustNote: Drafts first — publishing requires your approval.

mail-reply-auto.title: Automatic mail drafts
mail-reply-auto.description: Creates reply drafts for unread Gmail/Outlook mail — nothing sends until you approve in Messages.
mail-reply-auto.explainer: The job picks unread mail, writes a reply draft, and puts it in Messages. You can send, edit or discard — the automation never sends on its own.
mail-reply-auto.exampleDraft: Hi Anna! Thanks for your inquiry — absolutely, we have time. Suggest Tuesday or Thursday 10:00.
mail-reply-auto.trustNote: Draft before send — no mail goes out without you.

marketing-actions.title: Marketing actions
marketing-actions.description: Automatically pauses Meta campaigns rated F/poor by analytics (Google flagged for manual review).

weekly-insight-digest.title: Weekly insight digest
weekly-insight-digest.description: Monday email with ROAS trend, published posts and content tips when the social feed is active.

engagement-followup.title: Engagement follow-up
engagement-followup.description: Emails when unread DMs pile up so you don’t miss purchase intent or questions.

daily-digest.title: Daily digest
daily-digest.description: Morning email every weekday with what needs doing.

lead-reminder.title: Lead reminder
lead-reminder.description: Email when leads need follow-up today or are overdue.

task-reminder.title: Task reminder
task-reminder.description: Email with overdue and today’s tasks.

marketing-alerts.title: Marketing alerts
marketing-alerts.description: Email when ROAS drops below 1× or ads run against empty shelves.

ai-recommendations-refresh.title: AI recommendations
ai-recommendations-refresh.description: Refreshes recommendations from connections, tasks and content.

marketing-snapshot.title: Marketing snapshot
marketing-snapshot.description: Saves today’s ad KPIs so the weekly trend on Marketing stays complete.

social-stats-snapshot.title: Social stats snapshot
social-stats-snapshot.description: Saves daily follower and engagement figures per account so Social can show trends, not just snapshots.

market-pulse-snapshot.title: Market pulse snapshot
market-pulse-snapshot.description: Fetches LunarCrush sentiment every night so Home loads without a live MCP call.
